title: Grateful Dead Live at Cole Field House, U of Maryland on 1981-03-07
venue: Cole Field House, U of Maryland
lineage: FOB> Nak 700 mics> Sony TCD5M> MC> Sony D8> DAT@48k> ZA2> @44.1khz> SF & CD Architect4.5> CD

ai_review.summary: Strong first‑set jams and a late‑night Truckin’/Johnny B. Goode burst shine through, but the tape suffers from missing Passenger and second‑set drums and the acoustics of a field‑house venue.
ai_review.review: The concert delivers solid Dead energy with great first‑set improvisations and a memorable finish featuring Truckin' and Johnny B. Goode. Recording quality is only fair – an audience capture in Cole Field House that misses Passenger and the second‑set drum segment, yet it remains one of the better available copies despite those gaps.

ai_rating.rationale: Two 4‑star reviews praise the performance and deem the sound superior for a field‑house capture, while one 3‑star review notes recording limitations and a 0‑star spam entry adds little value. Overall the show is good but the audio is only fair.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captured in a basketball/field house, resulting in less than ideal acoustics; some reviewers call it the best available copy despite missing Passenger and second‑set drums.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is highlighted for its strong jams, while the second set is seen as more complex but ends on a high note with Truckin' and Johnny B. Goode.
